targets.name: tinyxml2

prepare.replace: # cmake_policy(SET CMP0063 OLD)  # CMake 4 refuses OLD policies

targets.note: 2018 release. One large test (xmltest). CRLF sources. Small and fast: about 40 seconds. Needs one CMake line disabled to configure under CMake 4.

targets.name: jsoncpp
targets.note: 2020 release, already partly modernized upstream. Three tests, one of them flaky when run in parallel. About 6 minutes.

targets.name: leveldb
targets.note: 2019 release. 30 tests, heavy use of raw pointers: the natural target for R2. Slow: a baseline alone takes about 7 minutes, a full run is hours.
